cases.name: Ashley Scoggins
cases.about: “My sister was amazing, she really was,” Ashley’s sister, Shelby said. “She was who you wanted in your corner if your back was against the wall. She was my big sister, and no matter what kind of argument we got into, I knew that she would always just be there for me if I needed her.”
cases.narrative: He allegedly stabbed her to death inside the Silver Express gas station on East King Street in Kings Mountain, NC.
